reference_onset_coincidence.caveat: reference-onset coincidence counts output onsets within +/-30 ms of PRISTINE-MUSIC onsets; it does NOT identify neighbouring Taiko and must not be read as source-specific Taiko suppression.

dynamics.definition: per oracle event over [t-15ms, t+150ms]: raw peak vs output peak; corr is amplitude-vs-amplitude (NOT the invalid corr(peak_ratio, raw_peak)); missed events keep their (near-zero) output peaks and are listed explicitly. This measures level behaviour, NOT physical force.
